scope: Post-matrix exploratory combination on the repeated 4977-row scenario-disjoint development population; not independent confirmation and not a new architecture

motivation_observed_before_protocol.interpretation: The completed arms have complementary errors. This motivates exactly one equal-weight consensus; the oracle union is not an achieved model result. The existing arm outcomes were inspected before this follow-up was chosen.

probability_postprocessing: None; do not renormalize, calibrate, clip or tune the consensus before prediction. Metric-specific numerical clipping remains exactly as in the existing metric functions.
missing_rows_or_folds: Fail closed; all rows, all five folds, all three seeds and source hashes must verify
forbidden: row filtering by labels or correctness
selection of a best weight after evaluation

statistics.bootstrap_unit: Scenario; resample the same 11 scenario indices for candidate and comparator
statistics.confidence_interval: Two-sided percentile 95%; fixed three classes and zero_division=0, retaining all draws
statistics.scenario_swap_test: All 2048 paired scenario swaps, as in existing run_okutama_video_probe.paired_statistics
statistics.multiplicity: Report raw and Holm-adjusted directional swap p-values across these two follow-up comparisons only. This does not correct the preceding research search and does not create confirmatory significance.
statistics.interpretation: Exploratory descriptive uncertainty on reused development scenarios, not independent confirmation

engineering_checks.note: Report these inherited practical checks without promoting an independent architecture or selecting another mixture if any check fails.

retention: Retain the complete result even if it fails; never overwrite original execution artifacts or retry with a different weight
